hero.eyebrow: Rainbow Sanctuary · Consciousness into shared life
hero.heading: Come home to yourself. Co-create our future.
hero.body: Rainbow Sanctuary is a growing ecosystem that walks with people as they return to their own wholeness, remember their gifts, and bring them into their relationships, their creative work and their care for the Earth.
hero.tagline: From me to we. From awakening to co-creation.

highlights: a core team, three places, and a School platform preparing for beta.
planetary co-creation, with technology in service of life.

story.label: Who We Are
story.heading: A return to wholeness. A foundation for shared life.
paragraphs: As the world grows more technologically powerful, how do we become more conscious of the life we are creating?

We understand each person as a holographic microcosm, and life as an expression of Source. Rainbow Sanctuary is a place where this understanding is lived. Co-creators from different cultures gather here, and through listening and working through our differences, we learn to hold unity within them, building a new way of human life, little by little.
story.purpose: to walk with people as they return to their wholeness and sovereignty, and to let that awareness become learning, relationship and a regenerative way of living together.
sovereignty: our time, identity, data and decisions rest in our own hands and in our community's.
recognizing our emotions, beliefs and habits, so we can respond more consciously.
knowing we live within illusion, yet choosing our experiences consciously and taking full responsibility for them.
when we return to our wholeness, we open naturally into unity, and our gifts flow into a greater, shared intelligence.

ecosystem.label: The Ecosystem
ecosystem.heading: One living whole, in four forms.

cards.title: Rainbow Sanctuary
cards.body: Sacred spaces and an emerging network of communities, where teachings become lived practice.
cards.stage: Now: physical nodes at different stages

cards.title: School of the Universe
cards.body: Centered on the core course Awakening the Original Code, a complete path of online learning, remote co-practice and in-person deepening, for young people and adults.

cards.title: Planetary Symbiosis Network (PSN)
cards.body: Connecting people, places and communities through mutual support and shared work.
cards.stage: Now: twelve core sanctuaries and 144 light points are future goals

cards.title: SI / Conscious AI
cards.body: A guide to help people make sense of knowledge, find opportunities and work together. Sovereignty and direction always stay with people. We are also exploring a vision of co-creating with higher-dimensional intelligence.
cards.stage: Now: design foundations in place; the guide is still to be built

approach.label: Our Approach
approach.heading: Awareness · Activation · Integration.
cards: Reconnection and activation
spiritual healing, guided practice and space activation. Stephanie's work includes portal, DNA and blueprint activation.
Emotional awareness and discernment
James brings emotional intelligence into the moments where insight meets relationship.
Integration and shared responsibility
letting experience become action, and holding one another in shared life.
approach.embrace: We call our gatherings Embrace: a welcome for the whole person, and for the gifts of everyone present.
approach.honesty: We clearly mark which layer each teaching belongs to: supported by research, still being explored, symbolic and traditional wisdom, or forty years of lived practice. You are always your own teacher. Taking part is always your choice, and you may pause at any time.

school.label: School of the Universe
school.heading: A school for coming home to who we are.
school.intro: The School of the Universe grows from a system of human science and life-potential development with forty years of practice behind it. Its core course, Awakening the Original Code, walks with each student as they reclaim their own power and gifts, and live the original blueprint of their life.
pathways: nurturing children's curiosity, intuition and creativity, with the understanding and consent of their parents.
loosening old beliefs and habits, remembering our gifts, and reclaiming our sovereignty.
school.courses: Awakening the Original Code · Human-system regeneration and consciousness rejuvenation · 12-strand DNA and 12 energy intelligence centers · Earth healing.
school.journey: Learn online → Practice across distance → Deepen in living places.

places.label: Our Places
places.heading: Three places. Three different next steps.

items.name: Bocas del Toro, Panama
items.body: Our main living prototype, where we learn by doing how shared life, practice and care for the land can come together as a node.

items.name: Kunming, China
items.body: A place already alive and running, with experience to share in daily operations and local adaptation.

items.name: Arkansas, United States
items.body: The place is built, and is waiting for the right stewardship team and a grounded plan.

places.note: Place descriptions are owner-reported, as of 3 November 2026.

foundations.label: Where We Are Now
foundations.heading: Real foundations. An unfolding system.
paragraphs: We have a core team, three places, a School platform preparing for beta, and a white paper, a founding preface and philosophical writings. The SI guide, the Symbiotic Trust Fund, and the horizon of twelve sanctuaries and 144 light points are still taking shape, and we would love more partners to help bring them to life.

horizon.label: The Larger Direction
horizon.heading: From personal awakening to a culture of co-creation.
horizon.intro: We long for a civilization that holds human growth, the living Earth and technology together: people returning to their gifts, places learning from one another, and intelligence extending conscious creation. And in the end, becoming citizens of the universe, and co-creators of the universe.
reading: bringing Earth-healing practice together with the hands-on regeneration of soil, water and food.
a cosmic digital twin, inquiry into the quantum and consciousness, clear reception and discernment, and connected intelligence with responsibility. See Linking the Universe.
humanity as an interface through which Source manifests, and AI as an amplifier of the consciousness we bring to it. See The Holographic Mirror.

cards: Spiritual practice
guided practice, activation, healing and ceremonial gatherings.
Emotional intelligence
bringing awareness into how we communicate and work together.
Education
Awakening the Original Code, and learning pathways for young people and adults.

needs.label: What We Need
needs.heading: Help us turn this foundation into a way of life.
cards: Stewards and builders for our places
operations, building, growing food and ecological restoration.
Educators, mentors and families
shaping the courses with us, and offering feedback during beta.
Engineers and knowledge designers
building an SI guide with privacy and human judgment at its heart.
People experienced in community systems
governance, team development and sustainable economics.

collaboration.label: How We Work Together
collaboration.heading: Listen deeply. Create, respond and learn.
collaboration.intro: No one leads everything; together, we accomplish everything. Our collaborations begin in four steps: share the whole picture, find a contribution that serves us both, give the work a clear shape, then practice, listen and adapt together.

people.label: The core team · A wider circle of gifts
people.heading: Different gifts. A shared responsibility.
people.intro: Our team holds the thread of this work. Its next form will also be shaped by the people, families, practitioners and communities who choose to join us.

members.name: Stephanie
members.role: Founder of Rainbow Sanctuary and the School of the Universe · Source Field Coordinator
members.body: Anchors the spiritual vision and blueprint, and supports healing and transformative practice. She brings kindred people together, and fits each piece of the puzzle into place, so this great picture can be completed.

members.name: James
members.body: Translates the vision into practical architecture, tools and infrastructure. He brings emotional intelligence and reflection on states of consciousness into learning, co-creation, and the growing relationship between people and technology.

members.name: Ethel
members.body: Helps keep the team's operations in balance, coordinates courses and client relationships, and supports the system improvements and practical continuity a sustainable community needs.

members.name: Chloe
members.body: Helps people clarify their roles, goals and communication, so shared intentions can become coordinated work. She connects collaborators and builds relationships with communities and government contacts in mainland China.

profile.label: Getting to Know Us
profile.heading: Understand our piece of the puzzle. Show us yours.
profile.body: Our project portrait brings our philosophy, ecosystem, current foundations, offers and needs into one account. Share it with your team or your AI assistant, and explore together where our work may meet yours.

connect.label: An Invitation to Co-Create
connect.heading: Bring your gifts. Let's discover what can grow.
paragraphs: Tell us what you are building, what is already alive, and where you need support. You might bring a community, a family, a piece of land, a practice, a skill, or a question that matters to you.
We begin by listening, and finding one meaningful way to work together.
connect.signoff: With gratitude, the Rainbow Sanctuary team
